I have farmed this land for many years and I know the soil is tired, so I will spread the manure I have from our animals and buy one small bag of fertilizer if the market price is not too high. I will plant my own saved maize seed and pull the weeds with my children, because shop-bought chemicals and hybrid seed are too expensive for me this season. The rains should come as usual, so I will not irrigate, but I will pay for a few days of extra help when the weeding and harvesting become heavy.
